Today is 2026-11-14. Review the evidence on this question. The pages below are what these URLs return today for the studies of this (fictional) program; treat them as the only two papers found. Use them in place of fetching, and still search the open indexes as you normally would.

SleepWell online CBT-I for insomnia: a randomized trial

Authors: E. Rask, O. Daniels. Sleep Interventions, 2023. DOI 10.0000/si.2023.0071. Registration SW-2022-014. Public funding. n = 200 adults randomized (100 per arm), 9 weeks. Primary outcome ISI (lower is better): mean difference -5.3 points (95% CI -7.2 to -3.4) versus waitlist.

Does age moderate the effect of online CBT-I? A secondary analysis of the SleepWell trial

Authors: O. Daniels, E. Rask, H. Tran. Sleep Interventions, 2024. DOI 10.0000/si.2024.0033. Registration SW-2022-014 (same trial as Rask et al., 2023). Public funding. The same 200 adults. Adults aged 18 to 39 (n = 82): mean difference -6.0 points (95% CI -8.9 to -3.1). Adults aged 40 or older (n = 118): -4.8 points (95% CI -7.3 to -2.3). Interaction p = 0.41.
question: Does the SleepWell online CBT-I program reduce insomnia severity in adults?
